(bhLm khhyLyn khwh chwnkh) khw szy gLthjryyhkhyn lYdhstYnYt w (dhynkth phndw gLthjR), y'hwh jrY bhrhLy krdwwn t kwYrnh ml bnYn w drYjh bhgwmRyy khoeyn bdhn.

khhrykh tyshky brwskhkh bynyy chwyn bhrYt, hhr ktYk bhr pYyn Roeshn dhkthwh, dhRoen, hhr kh tyshkhkh nhmw tryk bww lYyn, (dhsLhmYnhwh w) hhLwYsth dhkhn, khoe y'hghr khw bywystyh bystn w bynynyny lhnw dhbrd, bhRsty khw dhshLty bhshr hhmww shtYkd hhyh.
y'hy khhLkynh phrwhrdgry khoetn bphrstn, y'hw zthy kh y'Ywh w pYshynny y'Ywhshy bhdy hYnwh, boe y'hwhy RYbzy khwnsy w thqw w prYzkry bgrnh bhr.

j y'hghr y'Ywh lh dww dLydn w gwmntn lhm (qwry'nh pyroezh) hhyh kh dmnbhzndwwh boe bhndhy khoemn mHmd (Sly llh `lyh wslm) y'hghr boetn dhkrYt y'Ywhsh hhwL bdhn swwrhtYky whk y'hw bhYnn, hwphymn w hwkrhknyshtn jgh lh khw (boe y'hw mhbhsth) bng bkhn y'hghr y'Ywh Rst dhkhn.
khoe y'hghr nhtntwny w hhrgyz nyshtwnn (khwth bwhRbhYnn w) khoetn bprYzn lhw y'grhy: swwthmhnyhkhy khLky w bhrdh, kh boe bY bwhR w khwnhnsn y'mdh krwh.

(y'hy pYGhmbhr (Sly llh `lyh wslm) mjdh bdh bhwnhy kh bwhRyn hYnwh w krw krdhwh chkhknyn y'hnjmdwh bhwhy bkhhkny bhhhsht kh chhndhh Rwbr bhjYrdrhkht w bhnw bkhhknyd dhRwt, bhRsty boeyn y'mdhyh, hhrktYk lh mywhw bhrhhmYky y'hw bkhnhyn boe dhhYnn, dhLYn: y'Yst lhwhtn hYn, twYk lhmhw pYsh khwrdmn, hhr dhyhYnyn w lhyhktrysh dhchn, (lh Rhng w RwLhtd, bhLm lhtm w boend zoer jywzn), hhrwhh lhwYd hwshrny pk w bY ghrdyn boe y'mdhkrwh (y'hw bhkhthwhrnh) jyny hhmyshhyy w nhbRwh lhw bhhhshthd dhbhnh shr.

bhRsty khw bky nyhw nhng nyh bhlyhwh hhr nmwwnhyhk bhYnYthwh bh mYshwlhyhk, lhwysh bchwwktr bYt yn ghwrhtr, j y'hwnhy y'ymn w bwhRyn hYnwh, y'hwh chk dhznn y'hm nmwnhyh Rsth w lh lyhn phrwhrdgrynhwhyh, y'hwnhsh kfrw bY bwhRn dhLYn: khw mhbhsty chy bww lhm nmwwnhyhd? (khwy ghwrhsh dhfhrmwYt) zoerYky pY gwmR dhkt w zoerYky tryshy pY hydyht w RYnmwwy dhkt, bhLm dyrh jgh lh lrw wYrw ykhy w twnbrn khsy tr gwmR nkt...

y'hwnhy phymny khw (kh lh Rwwy fytrht w srwsht w phymhkny khwwh) hhynh, (kh dhbYt khwns bn) hhLdhwhshYnnhwh w phyRhwy nkhn lhdwy bhhYzw pthw bwwny, y'hw phywhndyynhsh dhpsYnn kh khw fhrmny ghyndny dwh, lhzhwyshd twn w khrph dhchYnn, y' y'hwnh khoeyn zhrhrmhnd w khhsrhtmhndn.

(y'hy mHmd (Sly llh `lyh wslm) bsy y'hwh bkh lh dYryn zhmnd) phrwhrdgrt bh fryshthkny wt: bhRsty mn dhmhwYt lh zhwyd jYnshynYk dbnYm (boe y'whdny w dyndry), fryshthkn wtyn: y'y khsYky tyd dhkhyth jYnshyn kh khrphw twny tyd bchYnYt w khwYnrYjy tYd y'hnjm bdt?! lhktYkd y'Ymh thsbyHt w swps w stysht dhkhyn w qhdrw RYzy toe chk dhznyn w bhdwwrt dhgryn lhw shtnhy shysthy toe nyn, (lhwhLmynd) khw fhrmwwy: bYgwmn y'hwhy y'Ywh nyznn mn dhyznm.

(y'ynj y'dhmy drwwst krd, wysty twnyy w lYhtwwy boe fryshthkn Rwwn bkthwh) nwy hhrchy pYwysty dhwrwbhr hhyh fYry krd, lhwhwdw bh fryshthkny Rnwnd w pYy fhrmwwn: y'dhy y'Ywh nwy y'hw shtnhm pY bLYn y'hghr Rst dhkhn w (twny y'whdnkrdnhwhy zhwytn hhyh?).

ktYkysh bhfryshthknmn wt: swjdh bhrn boe y'dhm (swjdhy RYzw bhfhrmny khw, whkw Rwwghyhk) swjdhyn brd, jgh y'yblys nhbYt kh shrpYchy krdw khoey bh ghwrhzny w khoey khsth Ryzy kfrhknhwh.

byry ny`mhty Rzgrbwnyshtn bkhnhwh ktYk Rzgrmn krdn w lhdhst drw dhsthy fyr`hwn kh khrptryn szw y'zryn dhdn, kwRhkntnyn shrdhbRyn w y'frhthkntnyn dhhYshtnhwh (boe krhkhry w khzmht) y'hwhsh boe y'Ywh twshht w tqykrdnhwhyhky ghwrh bww boetn lhlyhn phrwhrdgrtnhwh (t psht bhw zth bbhstn w bRwy thwwtn pYy hhbYt).

(hhrwhh) lh nzw ny`mhthkny khw boetn y'hwhyh: y'Ymh hhwrmn boe krdn bh sYbhrw ghzoemn boe brndn w phlhwhry shhlqhmn boe nrdn, dh bkhoen lhw Rzq w Roezyyh chknhy kh pYmn bhkhshywwn (bhLm lhbhr bY dyny w sthmyn toeLhmn lYshndn), j whnhbYt y'hwnh sthmyn lh y'Ymh krd bYt bhLkw hhr sthmyn lh khoeyn dhkrd.
